title: Live Candidate Evidence Persistence Boundary Fix
user_summary: Resolve Provider DTO evidence target aliases such as book_overview.claim after Candidate Output Ref Registry, enrich Context-visible evidence keys into Snapshot locators, and persist Asset/Version/Evidence/Artifact without relaxing validators.
technical_summary: failure_boundary=EVIDENCE_VALIDATION_REJECTED caused by unknown target_output_ref=book_overview.claim before Candidate Registry. Added build_candidate_output_refs / resolve_provider_output_ref / SnapshotQuoteIndex / LiveModulePipelineDiagnostics. Primary alias book_overview.claim→book_overview.out when registered; ambiguous multi-candidate without claim_key still rejected. Evidence Validator hash/offset/cross-snapshot rules unchanged. Schema not relaxed. Private companion preserves provider_output_ref.
acceptance_criteria: Bailian DTO evidence_refs with book_overview.claim resolve after Candidate Registry; Valid Evidence≥1; Asset/Version/Evidence/Artifact written; persistence_complete=true; rejected evidence never starts ORM transaction.

data_compatibility.notes: No Migration. Failed retry3 DB retained read-only as CHG-055 reproduction evidence.
